task_spec: subject: unify FractalTerrain's local and global river networks into one graph so a single elevation pass and single collectUnits handle both (local rivers become first-class RiverNetwork members joined to the global meander graph)

scope: src/main/java/me/batata_1/fractal_terrain/hydrology/ (LocalRiverProvider, LocalDrainageTracer, GlobalNetworkBuilder, ChannelElevationAssigner, meanders/RiverNetwork, meanders/Channel) and math/spline/QuinticHermiteSpline
out-of-scope: the diffusion/ONNX decode pipeline (ml/), biome/world gen, GlobalRiverProvider coarse-grid math, carve/paint profile package internals (profile/) beyond how they consume units
out-of-scope: changing HydrologicalUnit record shape or the R-tree index type
constraints: MUST: no behavior regression provable via existing JavaExec harnesses (globalRiverTest, localRiverTest, meandersTest, pipelineTest)
MUST: run `gradle spotlessApply` before committing (palantirJavaFormat enforced by build)
MUST: build via cached gradle 9.2.1, not PATH's 8.14; Python is `py` not python3
MUST: collectUnits must NOT invent elevations - only resample and read Channel.bedElevations (user directive)
MUST: traceLocalNetwork returns nothing - it mutates the sim's network in place (user directive)
MUST: rasterizeGlobalMask dropped entirely - no per-pixel global boolean mask (user decision: 'drop the mask entirely')
SHOULD: keep RiverNetwork per-tile, single-threaded, no cross-tile shared state (existing invariant)
entry_points: math/spline/QuinticHermiteSpline.java:75 reSample - builds newT via arc-length binary search then discards it; must expose newT (or a resample-with-t variant) so bed can align
meanders/Channel.java:98 reSample - delegates to spline.reSample, leaves bedElevations stale; add bedElev(double t) + resample bedElevations here
meanders/Channel.java:38 bedElevations - per-point double[], null until assigned; javadoc stale (claims collectUnits reads it - it does not)
meanders/RiverNetwork.java:596 collectUnits + :643 addFeatureUnits - resamples raw spline and re-derives bed via decodedElev.sample() lerp; switch to Channel.reSample + read bedElevations
meanders/RiverNetwork.java:82 constructor + :189 split + :262 newNode - graph built only from NodeSpec/EdgeSpec in ctor; extract reusable insert-specs API
meanders/RiverNetwork.java:617 collectUnits removedPaths - oxbows are non-Channel NaN splines with no bedElevations (must keep an elevation source for them)
hydrology/ChannelElevationAssigner.java:34 assign - topo bed assignment; currently GLOBAL-only, called inside GlobalNetworkBuilder.build; must run AFTER local insertion over whole graph

hydrology/LocalDrainageTracer.java:63 traceLocalNetwork - GRID-frame, returns List<Channel>; :41 rasterizeGlobalMask (to delete); :164 buildLocalChannel; :190 addLocalChannelUnits (to fold into unified collectUnits)
hydrology/LocalRiverProvider.java:160 buildTile - crops PADDED->GRID at step 4, shiftUnits(+/-PAD) dance; reorder so crop/shift only at end
hydrology/HydrologyTileGeometry.java - GRID=512 PAD=1 PADDED=514; sampleBilinear/sampleLocal frame helpers
rejected_alternatives: keep rasterizeGlobalMask for pixel exclusion + only add network query for junctions - REJECTED by user (keeps two representations of global rivers)
handle exclusion via internal rasterization from sim.getChannels() - REJECTED by user in favor of full drop-the-mask (graph-driven)
re-walk arc length inside Channel to resample bed (H1) - dispreferred: two independent binary-search walks can diverge and misalign bed to points; expose newT instead
current_understanding: Per-tile pipeline (LocalRiverProvider.buildTile): decode padded 514 -> GlobalNetworkBuilder.build (trace+relax+assign bed) returns Meanders sim -> collectUnits(global, padded frame) -> carve global shell -> fillSinks+drainage on padded -> CROP to GRID 512 -> rasterizeGlobalMask -> traceLocalNetwork(GRID) -> addLocalChannelUnits(GRID) -> shiftUnits dance -> combined ImmutableRTree + cropped carved tile
RiverNetwork is a dendritic in-tree: nodes (SOURCE=1 out/0 in, DRAIN=0 out/>=1 in, JUNCTION>=1 in/1 out), channels are directed edges start->end; every node has <=1 outgoing

ChannelElevationAssigner: set SOURCE/DRAIN elev from boundaryElevByNodeIdx; resolveDrainElevations (memoized downstream walk); Kahn topo propagate junction elev = min of incoming; then per-channel bedElevations = monotone-non-increasing lerp start->end clamped to max(decodedTerrain,endElev) and floored at terminal drain
collectUnits currently: for each channel spline.reSample(width/2) then bed via i==0?startElev : lerp(max(decoded,endElev)->endElev); bedElevations field unused there
QuinticHermiteSpline.sample(t): id=clamp(floor(t),0,size-2), u=t-id, quintic hermite over p0/p1,v0/v1,a0/a1; reSample maps newT list through sample/firstDerivative/secondDerivative

LocalDrainageTracer: computeFlow -> computeReaches (backprop from globalMask|elev<0 seeds) -> riverMask=flow>=40 && reaches && !globalMask; build downstream/inDegree graph; walk segments from sources/junctions; drop segments that leave tile (onBorder); buildLocalChannel makes a Channel with width-from-flow taper
assumptions: bedElev(t) should be plain linear interpolation between bedElevations[id] and bedElevations[id+1] at u=t-id, mirroring sample()'s segment logic (H) - user said 'in the same way as QuinticHermiteSpline sample'
networks are per-tile and discarded, so collectUnits mutating channels in-place via Channel.reSample is safe (H)
coast DRAIN datum (elev<0) comes from bilinear decoded/carved terrain at the drain coordinate, fed into boundaryElevByNodeIdx (M)
proximity radius d for 'local river meets global channel' is a new HydrologyTuning constant needing runtime calibration (H)
the transient collision QuadTree cannot be reused for junction queries (cleared each step); a fresh point index over sim.getChannels() is needed for the local-attach pass (M)
invisible_knowledge: H1 keystone: bedElevations must be resampled on the SAME newT basis the spline used, or bed values misalign to points; QuinticHermiteSpline.reSample must surface newT
H2 trap: Channel.reSample is called with bedElevations==null in the ctor (RiverNetwork:105), buildLocalChannel (LocalDrainageTracer:177), and meander steps - resample must no-op bed when null
H3 trap: removedPaths/oxbows have no bedElevations and NaN endpoint elevations - removing the sampler lerp orphans their elevation; needs an explicit fallback
H4 ordering: assign() must move to AFTER local insertion and boundaryElevByNodeIdx must gain entries for local sources (ridge seeds) and coast drains, else locals get datum 0.0

H5 invariant: LocalDrainageTracer hardcodes GRID in neighborIndex/onBorder/leavesTile/sampleLocal; moving to PADDED changes what 'border' means - must still reject channels crossing the TRUE tile boundary, not the padded edge

H6 mechanism: junction attachment = nearest-global-channel-point spatial query -> split(channelId,pos,redirect) mints the JUNCTION; drop-the-mask means walk-termination (proximity to global channel) also replaces the !globalMask exclusion term, and computeReaches seeds become coast(elev<0) + cells adjacent to a global channel (derived from sim, not a passed mask)
proximity radius d is the knob that replaces the crisp pixel boundary: too small -> parallel double rivers, too large -> truncated local detail; validate via localRiverTest
feature-id space is a single shared int[] counter across global+local so units share one tile-unique id space
carveRiverShells for local floodplains is currently commented out in buildTile (LocalRiverProvider:213-215) - known accepted seam risk; do not silently re-enable
